subject: 6-month-demonstrator-detail

metrics.nhs_productivity: 6-month demonstrator: 22-axis measurement audit of 5 NHS AI deployments (radiology + pathology + GP triage + mental health + cancer screening). Outputs: signed audit cards, public dashboard, NHS-ready measurement standard.
metrics.compute_efficiency: 6-month demonstrator: signed inference efficiency receipts at pod scale. Measure 10 models × 5 axes. Publish methodology. Partner with ARIA Scaling Inference Lab.
metrics.defence_mission: 6-month demonstrator: DEFONEOS extension — 3 new defence-AI MCPs (CBRN response, autonomous vehicle safety, decision support). 33-agent BFT council voting on first DEFONEOS-SEAL.
metrics.agent_security: 6-month demonstrator: three-layer architecture deployment with 3 NHS trusts + 2 MoD units + 5 enterprise customers. Agent security incident broadcaster proven at scale.

honest_sentence: 6-month demonstrator detail per competition: NHS (5 audits), Compute (signed receipts), Defence (3 new MCPs), Agent (production deployments). All achievable with current infrastructure + 1-2 hires.
